# EroHub NSFW Detection API -- LLM Reference
# Base URL: https://your-domain.com (or http://localhost:8000 for dev)
# Auth: API key as Bearer token in Authorization header
# All image endpoints accept multipart/form-data with field "file"
# Box format: [x, y, width, height] (xywh) for all models
# Max upload: 50MB images, 200MB videos (auth), 10MB images (demo)

## Authentication
All endpoints except /demo/* and /health require an API key:
  Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx

## Detection Models

NudeNet (nudenet) -- YOLOv8m, 640m.onnx, 18 labels:
  FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED, FEMALE_BREAST_COVERED,
  FEMALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED, FEMALE_GENITALIA_COVERED,
  MALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED, MALE_GENITALIA_COVERED,
  BUTTOCKS_EXPOSED, BUTTOCKS_COVERED,
  ANUS_EXPOSED, ANUS_COVERED,
  BELLY_EXPOSED, BELLY_COVERED,
  ARMPITS_EXPOSED, ARMPITS_COVERED,
  FEET_EXPOSED, FEET_COVERED,
  FACE_FEMALE, FACE_MALE

EraX (erax) -- YOLO11s, 5 labels:
  NIPPLE, PENIS, VAGINA, ANUS, MAKE_LOVE

CLIP (clip-vit-base-patch32) -- used for age, deepfake, clothing, sexiness, embeddings

## Endpoints

### POST /classify
Detect NSFW content in an image. Returns detections + CLIP analysis.
Params: model=nudenet|erax (default: nudenet), no_cache=0|1
Response: {image_id, model, detections: [{label, score, box:[x,y,w,h]}], age?, deepfake?, clothing?}
Header: X-Cache: HIT|MISS

### POST /censor
Blur NSFW regions. Returns censored PNG image.
Params: model=nudenet|erax, labels=COMMA_SEPARATED (form field, optional)
Response: image/png binary
Headers: X-Image-Id, X-Estimated-Age, X-Minor-Risk, X-Deepfake-Verdict, X-Clothing

### POST /rateme
Multi-factor sexiness/attractiveness scoring. Runs NudeNet + EraX + CLIP.
Params: no_cache=0|1
Response: {image_id, models:["nudenet","erax"], rating:{score, category, description, factors:{...}}, detections:[...]}
Header: X-Cache: HIT|MISS
Factor weights: clip_sexiness=38%, eroticism=27%, image_quality=12%, composition=10%, aesthetics=8%, age_attractiveness=5%
Categories: safe(0-0.10), mild(0.10-0.25), suggestive(0.25-0.45), sensual(0.45-0.65), erotic(0.65-0.80), explicit(0.80-0.92), extreme(0.92-1.0), blocked(minor)

### POST /moderate
All-in-one content moderation. Runs NudeNet + EraX + CLIP + Rate-Me.
Params: no_cache=0|1
Response: {image_id, action:"allow"|"flag"|"block", confidence, reasons:[], detections, rating, clip_analysis:{sexiness,age,deepfake,clothing}, summary:{nudity_score,violence_score,text_flags}}
Header: X-Cache: HIT|MISS

### POST /batch
Process ZIP/RAR archive. Classifies all images inside.
Params: model=nudenet|erax
Response: {model, total, processed, errors, results:[{filename, image_id?, detections, error?}]}

### POST /embed
CLIP embedding vector for an image.
Params: normalize=true|false
Response: {image_id, embedding:[768 floats], dimensions:768, model:"clip-vit-base-patch32", normalized}

### POST /compare
Cosine similarity between two images via CLIP.
Fields: file1, file2 (both multipart)
Response: {similarity:float, is_similar:bool (>=0.85), embedding_model}

### POST /tag
Zero-shot labeling. Score image against custom text labels.
Fields: file (multipart), labels (form, comma-separated, max 50, max 200 chars each)
Response: {image_id, tags:[{label, score}], model}

### POST /faces
Detect faces only. Returns face locations.
Response: {image_id, faces:[{box, score, ...}], count}

### POST /anonymize
Detect and blur faces. Returns anonymized PNG.
Params: blur_radius=40 (5-200)
Response: image/png binary
Headers: X-Faces-Found, X-Image-Id

### POST /pose
Estimate body pose. Returns keypoints.
Response: {image_id, pose:{...}}

### POST /video/classify
Classify video frame by frame. No size/duration limits for auth users.
Params: model=nudenet|erax|ensemble, fps=1.0 (0.1-30), max_frames=0 (0=unlimited), async=true (optional)
Response: {video_id, model, video_info, settings, frames:[{timestamp, detections}], summary:{total_detections, labels_found, max_score, nsfw_frames, nsfw_percentage}}

### POST /video/censor
Censor video -- detect and blur NSFW regions.
Params: model, fps=5.0, max_frames=0, labels (form), blur_radius=60 (5-200), interpolate=true, async=true (optional)
Response: video/mp4 binary
Headers: X-Video-Id, X-Frames-Analyzed, X-Detections-Found

### POST /video/scenes
Extract NSFW scenes as compiled highlight video.
Params: model, fps=2.0 (0.5-10), min_scene_duration=2.0 (>=0.5), scene_padding=1.0 (>=0), async=true (optional)
Response: video/mp4 binary
Headers: X-Video-Id, X-Scenes-Found, X-Total-Duration, X-Scenes-Duration, X-Scenes-Metadata (JSON)

### Async jobs
POST /batch and authenticated POST /video/* accept async=true and return HTTP 202:
{job_id, status:"queued", status_url:"/jobs/{id}"}
GET /jobs/{id} returns progress, JSON result/error, and output_url when available.
GET /jobs/{id}/output downloads completed binary video output.
Terminal events are sent as job.completed or job.failed to HMAC webhooks with trigger=any.

### GET /images
List stored images. Params: category=censored|originals, limit=50 (max 200)
Response: {category, images:[{id, filename, size, created}]}

### GET /images/{category}/{image_id}
Retrieve stored image. category=originals|censored
Response: image file

### GET /storage/{category}/{filename}
Public image access by full filename (IDs contain UUID -- not guessable).
Response: image file

### GET /health
No auth. Response: {status:"ok", models:{nudenet:bool, erax:bool}, workers:{...}}

### GET /models
No auth. Response: {models:[{id, name, description, labels, default_censor}]}

## Errors
Format: {"detail": "error message"}
Status codes: 400 (bad request), 401 (unauthorized), 413 (file too large), 429 (rate limited), 503 (service unavailable)

## curl Examples

# Classify an image
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/classify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg" \
  -F "model=nudenet"

# Censor an image
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/censor \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg" \
  -o censored.png

# Rate an image
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/rateme \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Moderate an image
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/moderate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Zero-shot tagging
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/tag \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg" \
  -F "labels=beach scene,indoor photo,portrait,landscape"
